svg.title: Wireframe 01: Canvas
svg.desc: Canvas screen in Build mode. Navigation rail, top bar with save state, undo, redo, experiment picker and a disabled Run button with its reason. Palette of block types on the left, the coffee shop model in the centre with a newly added server_2 showing an error badge, the selected block's settings on the right, and the problems list under the canvas. Flow blocks are capsules and work blocks rounded boxes, each with an icon disc. Try a change sits beside the service mean and the queue capacity. An inset shows the delete confirmation dialog: Delete 1 block?, what it removes, a Don't ask me again tick box, Cancel (focused) and Delete.
svg.text: Added just now: E131 until its output is connected
This removes server_2 and 0 connections. You can undo
Inset: on a scrim; focus starts on Cancel; Escape cancels
The 'out' port of 'server_2' is not connected to anything. Connect it to another block or to a sink.
'server_2' cannot be reached from any source.
